mechanism: Dexamethasone induces CYP3A4 metabolism and may reduce cefepime levels; cephalosporins can increase seizure risk in susceptible patients, potentially exacerbated by corticosteroid-related CNS effects.
action: Monitor clinical response to cefepime therapy; consider dosage adjustment if needed; observe for reduced antimicrobial efficacy and increased seizure risk, particularly at high cefepime doses.
